description: This file contains functions and logic related to managing deferred revenue and deferred expense accounting in an ERP system, including validation, conversion, booking, and reporting functionalities for deferred transactions.

methods.name: validate_service_stop_date(doc)
methods.description: Validates that the service stop date is not before the start date or after the end date, and that it cannot be changed once set in existing documents.

methods.name: build_conditions(process_type, account, company)
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions for querying deferred revenue or expense items based on process type, account, and company.

methods.name: convert_deferred_expense_to_expense(deferred_process, start_date=None, end_date=None, conditions='')
methods.description: Books deferred expenses into actual expenses within a specified date range, based on related invoice data.

methods.name: convert_deferred_revenue_to_income(deferred_process, start_date=None, end_date=None, conditions='')
methods.description: Books deferred revenue into income within a specified date range, based on related invoice data.

methods.name: get_booking_dates(doc, item, posting_date=None)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate start and end dates for booking deferred revenue/expense, based on previous GL entries and service dates.

methods.name: calculate_monthly_amount(doc, item, last_gl_entry, start_date, end_date, total_days, total_booking_days, account_currency)
methods.description: Calculates apportioned amount and base amount for monthly booking of deferred revenue/expense.

methods.name: calculate_amount(doc, item, last_gl_entry, total_days, total_booking_days, account_currency)
methods.description: Calculates apportioned amount and base amount for deferred revenue/expense, usually for non-monthly allocations.

methods.name: get_already_booked_amount(doc, item)
methods.description: Retrieves the already booked amount for a given invoice item, considering both GL entries and journal entries.

methods.name: book_deferred_income_or_expense(doc, deferred_process, posting_date=None)
methods.description: Handles the process of booking deferred revenue or expense into general ledger or via journal entries, based on configuration.

methods.name: process_deferred_accounting(posting_date=None)
methods.description: Main function to convert deferred accounts into actual income or expenses, usually scheduled as a background job.

methods.name: make_gl_entries(doc, credit_account, debit_account, against, amount, base_amount, posting_date, project, account_currency, cost_center, item, deferred_process=None)
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for revenue or expense, handling both credit and debit sides.

methods.name: send_mail(deferred_process)
methods.description: Sends notification email to system managers if deferred accounting processing encounters errors.

methods.name: book_revenue_via_journal_entry(doc, credit_account, debit_account, against, amount, base_amount, posting_date, project, account_currency, cost_center, item, deferred_process=None, submit='No')
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a journal entry for deferred revenue or expense, linking it to related documents.
